summary: Access lifecycle: repeatable admission event types and partial singleton uniqueness

comments.body:
<!-- sdlc:stage=backlog kind=summary -->
Spawned by TKT-73 / ADR-025 (admission lifecycle events and offline reconciliation). The ADR's decision statements are binding constraints on this ticket.

<!-- sdlc:stage=ready kind=claim -->
Claimed: only ticket in Ready, zero open blockers, branch `TKT-84-repeatable-admission-events` created off origin/main.

**GATE WAIVER (recorded per repo owner's explicit instruction):** the repo owner is deliberately waiving all four human gates for this run as a process experiment — this ticket runs Ready→Done gateless in one continuous autonomous run. Replacements: Gate 1 = ticket already in Ready; Gate 2 = agent resolves open decisions itself (prefer critique's recommendation, else most-reversible; rationale recorded in plan-final); Gate 3 = agent squash-merges after adversarial ai-review converges, review-guide posted first as audit record; Gate 4 = agent self-validates COS against test evidence on merged code. All other skill rules unchanged (config.models routing, cross-model review, TDD red-first, local gate green, markers, no AI attribution).

description: Implement ADR-025 §D1/3/4/5/7/8 in the access store: widen the event_type CHECK to entry/exit/duplicate_admit; partial unique index over (ticket_id,event_type) WHERE event_type IN ('issued','delivered','redeemed') created BEFORE dropping the table-wide UNIQUE (binding order, ADR-025 §D7); per-occurrence UUIDv4 event ids for repeatable types (deterministic id stays for redeemed); idempotency by event id resolved before appendLifecycle under the ticket lock; History exposes/orders by integrity sequence alongside occurred_at. Plain CREATE UNIQUE INDEX (ADR-020), out-of-band migrate job (ADR-022) — MEASURE the COMPLETE migration (widened CHECK validation scan + index build — two table scans) at representative volume against the 30s bound before shipping; the new CHECK needs a distinct constraint name while the old one exists (ADR-025 §D7). Canonical v1 and golden literals unchanged. Seams: migration_smoke_test.go, lifecycle_smoke_test.go.
